policy: Only separately verified prerequisite inversions are listed. Unlisted cards keep the existing level/id relative order.

rules.reason: Learn atomic int() conversion before the composite int(input(...)) call.
Use input(), int(), and arithmetic only after the int(input(...)) bridge.
Introduce function definition before combining definition and call execution.
Introduce call and return independently before tracing a returned value into assignment.
Contrast print and return only after both function call and return semantics have been introduced.
Nested calls require call, argument binding, and returned-value flow first.
Nested evaluation order is a composite exercise after basic return flow.
Passing one function's return value into another call follows basic return flow.
Learn function definition and return independently before the combined def+return+call example.
Learn startswith() on a single string before using it inside a function+for+if counting flow.
Learn startswith() independently before combining it with loop search, assignment, and break.
Introduce generator-expression execution before combining it with membership checks and all().
Introduce environment-variable lookup before applying it to secret/API-key presence logic.

prelearn_support.reason: Show dict.items() and list(iterable) before the nested list(data.items()) example.
Show reversed() and list(iterable) before the nested list(reversed(...)) example.
Reinforce reversed() before tracing that the original list stays unchanged.
Show insert() mutation semantics before focusing on its positional arguments.
Show zip() pairing and list(iterable) before consuming zip pairs into a list.
